photocopier.notes: Source photocopier1 operation frames/timing, photocopier2 maintenance source retained. Separate input/output anchors; documents and books are runtime attachments.

library_scanner.notes: Source bigscanner1 operation frames/timing, bigscanner2 maintenance source retained. Separate input/output anchors; documents and books are runtime attachments.

bookbinder.notes: Source binder1 operation frames/timing, binder2 maintenance source retained. Separate input/output anchors; documents and books are runtime attachments.

pda_painter.notes: Department variants share original pdapainter. Separate lid, power/broken panel states and PDA attachment; device paint is runtime data.

photobooth.notes: Hollow booth with seat, original flat curtain shown by closed/open state clips. Security uses same geometry. Occupant/photo items separate; curtain deliberately stays 2D.

biogenerator.notes: Seven exclusive original biomass fill levels, screen/work/container overlays, separate hatch. Organic contents and reagent containers remain runtime objects.

seed_extractor.notes: Main scanner and side seed outlet, separate source maintenance cover. No source processing animation; product objects are separate.

washing_machine.notes: Hollow cabinet, rotating drum and hinged circular door. Empty/full/bloody source content layers. Clothes are runtime attachments; running blood effect remains source metadata.

coffee_machine_impressa.notes: Tabletop Impressa with actual pot cavity and dispenser nozzle. Pot, cups, sugar and bean attachments are dynamic; their original source overlays retained, not baked into body.

kitchen_oven.notes: Hollow oven, tray and bottom-hinged framed glass door. Source on/off lamp. Range adds two burners; oven has a tall backguard. Food and flame visuals are runtime attachments.

kitchen_range.notes: Hollow oven, tray and bottom-hinged framed glass door. Source on/off lamp. Range adds two burners; oven has a tall backguard. Food and flame visuals are runtime attachments.

griddle.notes: One shared griddle for the three source control variants; original flat cooking surface remains clear for dynamically placed food. Food stand subtype is not present in this audit.

deep_fryer.notes: Two independently modelled baskets with handles and lowering/raising clips; off/on controls. Source start/stop interpreted as physical basket movement. Grease overlay and oil bubbles remain source metadata for runtime.

food_processor.notes: Same geometry layout for food/slime variants; original palette atlas and separate side maintenance cover. No invented rotating exterior; processing uses contents and sound in source.

slime_processor.notes: Same geometry layout for food/slime variants; original palette atlas and separate side maintenance cover. No invented rotating exterior; processing uses contents and sound in source.

gibber.notes: Open feed with opposing rotating jaws, source empty/loaded/active indicators. Body contents and blood tint/decal are runtime-owned; no body or gore baked into geometry.

food_cart.notes: Wheeled serving cart with original parasol silhouette and top compartments. Food and icecream selections supplied at runtime; no duplicate copies per menu item.

icecream_cart.notes: Wheeled serving cart with original parasol silhouette and top compartments. Food and icecream selections supplied at runtime; no duplicate copies per menu item.
